﻿from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def _load_module(path: Path, module_name: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec and spec.loader
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def test_level1_uses_udi_binding_for_menu_resolution():
    path = (
        ROOT
        / "Projects"
        / "Applications"
        / "PrismataLabs"
        / "examples"
        / "pcms_2026_level1_single_pane.py"
    )
    module = _load_module(path, "pcms_level1")
    panes, _ = module._build_panes_from_framework("single-pane.ui-framework.yaml")

    assert panes
    assert panes[0]["menu"]["udi"] == "prismata.examples.menu.single-pane"

    source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "menu_index = {m.get(\"id\")" not in source
    assert "pane_bindings.get(pane_data.get(\"id\"))" not in source
    assert "ROLE_ALIASES" not in source
    assert "BORDER_ALIASES" not in source
    assert "menu-items" not in source
